summary: Loads tire and wheel graphics meshes by looping over file entries. Opens an audio stream for the tire sound handle a2, maps global detail level dword_7CF884 through jump table jpt_4A5216 to an LOD scale factor (3.0/2.0/1.0/0.0), then iterates data entries via ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag, resolving each name through global instance table aInstance and handing it to TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader. Performs conditional handle cleanup and field-free return. Invoked by sub_4A4900.

operations.description: Zero-initialize local file-handle state struct v7 via ZeroInitSmallStruct (function identity 0x004A51C0).
Open audio stream for tire sound using handle argument a2 and a constant flag argument 1 via AudioStreamOpen.
Early return when v7[0] is zero (init/allocation result from ZeroInitSmallStruct), returning SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v7).
Map global detail level dword_7CF884 (0..3) through jump table jpt_4A5216 to LOD scale factor v6 (3.0 for 0, 2.0 for 1, 1.0 for 2, 0.0 for 3; default 0.0).
Clear 384-byte buffer v15 and initialize locals v10=0, v12=0, v13=0, v14=0, v11=1.
Iterate data entries while ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v15, 384) returns true.
Skip mesh load when sub_5651B0(v9) returns non-zero (file-entry load/parse result).
Resolve name key v8 against global instance table aInstance via sub_565520(aInstance, v8, 0).
Load tire/wheel graphics mesh via TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader(this, v5, v7, v8, a3, v6) using the resolved name, entry handle and LOD scale factor.
Close file handle and dispatch on flag after the loop via ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v7).
Return conditional field-free result via SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v7); function is called by sub_4A4900.
